name: Crypto price-level alerts to Telegram (fire once, re-arm)

parameters.content:
## Price level alerts
Define levels like `BTCUSDT>100000, ETHUSDT<2500`. Alerts once when price crosses the level. Re-arms only after price stays on the safe side for two scheduled runs. On a fresh import, a level that is already past is seeded as fired (no instant alert).

Uses Binance public market data (data-api.binance.vision), no key, works from regions where binance.com is blocked.
